messages:
Jamie: Quick ops thread — starting an Account Sentry pilot (scorecard + dry-run) to surface accounts that need enablement, stale ownership, or low-touch cadence. Plan to run a non-actionable sweep next Tue and drop results to #cs-ops-results. Thoughts?

Leo: Nice. Two quick Qs — 1) what counts as 'low-touch'? 2) is pilot flag-only or will it auto-assign?

Priya: For pilot, flag-only please. Threshold suggestion: last touch >60 days OR fewer than 3 touches in 90d. Exclude trial-only accounts. @Jamie can we also check for missing enablement artifacts?

Maria: Quick test query (pseudo) to prototype:```
SELECT account_id, last_touch, touch_count_90d, enablement_completed
FROM accounts
WHERE last_touch < now() - interval '60 days'
```
Will join contacts to ensure there's a rep email. Also recommend ignoring accounts with active escalations.

ops-bot: Scheduled job created — AccountSentry-dryrun -> weekly Tue 07:00 UTC. Job ID: AS-20260322-01

Leo: :thumbsup: For the scorecard columns let's include risk_reason and suggested_action so triage is quicker.

Priya: Agreed. Suggested actions (pilot): 'Assign CSM', 'Start enablement play', 'Send re-engagement email', 'Close as churn-risk'. We'll map actions to templates.

Jamie: Plan: run dry-run next Tue, export CSV to #cs-ops-results, triage list Thu. @Leo you'll own triage? @Priya you own action mapping/templates?

Leo: I can own triage.

Priya: I'll own mapping + email/templates.

Maria: I'll add optimized SQL + a flag to skip accounts with active escalations or ongoing renewals. Also will add contact dedupe before counting touches.

Jamie: Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/842 — assigning @Leo @Priya. Scheduling a quick sync Wed 09:00 PT to review dry-run outcomes and iterate thresholds.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Account Sentry Kickoff — Wed 09:00 PT (reminder 30m)
